verdict.rationale: The Zoho Books API docs publish a "Download Zoho Books OpenAPI Document" link to openapi-all.zip, a 340KB+ archive of the full OpenAPI corpus that was live-verified. The probe's 404s hit only generic well-known paths such as /openapi.json, not the documented download location, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the zipped spec is complete and valid (e.g., OpenAPI version, coverage of all modules), and a single canonical unzipped spec URL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
